hooks.command: BRANCH=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if ! git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" diff --quiet || ! git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" diff --cached --quiet || [ -n "$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" add -A && git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" commit -m "Auto-save: cambios al cerrar sesión" && git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" push -u origin "$BRANCH"; fi 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: Guardando y subiendo cambios al repositorio...
